subject: [PATCH v2 1/2] mm: zswap: use separate compression and decompression requests

2026-10-09.patch_summary: This patch separates the compression and decompression requests in the zswap module, allowing them to run independently and reducing contention between high-priority loads and low-priority stores. This change is based on a proposal from Sergey Senozhatsky for similar splitting of requests in the zram module. The patch introduces new data structures to manage separate compression and decompression requests, and updates the acomp_ctx_free function to handle these changes.
